finding: The qualified numerical correction does not recover the measured secondary slowdown and accompanying depth rise at G2. On the coarse mesh, G2 level RMSE changes from 0.055899 to 0.055521 m and speed RMSE from 0.821976 to 0.838475 m/s. On the broader 0.05 m mesh, corrected G2 errors remain 0.055512 m and 0.825630 m/s. G4 speed improves on both meshes, while level errors are mixed. Correcting the demonstrated consistency failures therefore does not identify the physical cause of the G2 mismatch.
qualification: The corrected coarse run completes 120 seconds with all numerical checks passing. Twelve focused native tests and sixteen analytical jump/reflection cases pass, with no new failures in the broader tested marcher suite; its original porewater failure remains. The gradient-only ablation reaches G2 speed RMSE 0.560186 m/s, but retains known wall-state failures and is not a production alternative. Measured-data errors use the same recovered marker subset, whose independent digitization review is still outstanding. The two meshes do not establish convergence or successful laboratory validation. Canonical inputs and reviewed regression anchors remain unchanged. At 20 s the corrected sampled Fr=1 crossing shifts from x=2.9025 m on the coarse mesh to x=3.1475 m on the broader mesh, downstream of G2 at x=2.65 m. This spatial sensitivity reinforces the lack of a front-convergence result.
next_steps: 1. Add independent partially wet bank/wall hydrostatic and transient tests. Verify wetted face widths and integrated wall/bed pressure when water intersects the sloping banks; the present fully wet affine/lake tests and bank-energy counterexample do not qualify every shoreline regime.

2. Track the jump in its local normal direction and repeat a control-volume momentum/energy audit around G2 with the corrected operator. Re-establish bit-identical instrumentation before interpreting individual loss terms.

3. Resolve the drawing-versus-DEM building footprint and sampled throat-width differences from authoritative laboratory records. Any provenance-defined geometry alternatives should be separate declared sensitivities, without fitting dimensions to G2. Acquire the original measured time series and an independent digitization check.

4. Extend coordinated refinement with fixed physical inputs, then requalify Test 6B and the remaining UK problems on their correct constrained TINs. Do not promote regression anchors on the basis of this unresolved comparison.
